THE SMALL PRINT

Before the pitch.

An unofficial fan game about recognizing Theo’s sponsor setups. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Theo, t3.gg, YouTube, or any sponsor.

How to play

Listen to 5 seconds from the beginning of a setup. Type a sponsor name; suggestions appear only after you type. Arrow keys select a suggestion, Enter fills it, and a second Enter submits. Guessing is case-insensitive and accepts common aliases. The separate Sponsors page is optional study material.

A wrong guess unlocks 10 seconds, then 15, then 20. At 20 seconds, keep guessing as long as you like. Wrong answers never reveal the sponsor or advance the round. Only a correct guess or the explicit Reveal answer button unlocks Next. Replay is always available while guessing. You can revisit any unlocked listening window without losing access to the others.

Start with 1,000 potential points. Each extra listening window costs 250; each distinct incorrect known-brand guess costs 75. The minimum correct-answer score is 100. Unknown names and repeated guesses don’t cost points. An explicit reveal scores zero. Space plays/pauses and R replays outside inputs and controls.

The clip library

Every included occurrence offers the same cumulative 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 second windows, anchored at a reviewed setup transition. Short or uncertain setups are held out. Different creative reads from the same sponsor are welcome; duplicate creative identifiers are excluded. Shuffle visits each occurrence once before starting another cycle. Daily is stable for the UTC date and current library.

These are beta clips supported by caption research and visible official-player checks. Caption timings and recognition can be imperfect. Visual screenshot sampling is not frame-perfect review, and no direct auditory verification is claimed. Detailed source and start-audit notes are retained in the round metadata (contains answers). Report clip can flag a spoiler, late setup, duplicate, wrong sponsor, or unavailable video.

YouTube playback

The official YouTube player stays visible and unobscured with normal controls, branding, and full-video access. No hidden or background player, isolated YouTube audio, downloaded/rehosted media, or cloned voice is used. Titles, chapter names, captions, ads, user seeking, and playback delays may still spoil answers. This is a disclosed compromise of official embedded playback; cutoffs are best effort.

YouTube connects after Play. Its terms and Google privacy policy apply. Player design follows YouTube’s required player functionality. The player is removed before game dialogs open so no game overlay obscures it.

Privacy & reports

Stats, theme preferences, custom metadata, and reports are saved only in this browser. Authorized custom audio is stored locally in browser storage and never uploaded. Clearing site data removes it. No account, analytics, leaderboard, or automatic report delivery. Reports hide that clip locally and can be exported or reset in Your stats. A blocked embed can be retried, opened on YouTube, or explicitly skipped without scoring.
